subject: Marketplace listing RFI — listing formats, compliance & commercial requirements
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@globaltech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@globaltech.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing questionnaire and certification checklist

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Attached is GlobalTech's standard marketplace listing RFI (attached: globaltech_marketplace_questionnaire.xlsx). We need your team's responses to the sections below so our vendor ops team can evaluate Redwood for listing in the GlobalTech Cloud Marketplace (we publish offers across AWS, Azure, and GCP).

Top items we need answered:
- Supported listing formats (AWS SaaS, AMI, Azure Offer, GCP Marketplace SaaS/VM/Container) and any differences in capabilities for each.
- Billing/integration model (marketplace metering, private offers, direct billing options).
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, data residency commitments for US/EU, encryption & key management.
- Procurement flow: will Redwood accept marketplace-managed procurement (billing via GlobalTech), or do we require a direct contract/PO?
- Marketplace-specific SLAs and support model (SLA credits, support hours, escalation path).

Can you return a completed questionnaire and copies of the compliance artifacts by EOD Tuesday (Apr 21)? If you prefer, a short PDF with direct answers is fine — we don't need narrative beyond the checklist.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang\Vendor Programs Manager
GlobalTech

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@globaltech.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing questionnaire and certification checklist

Emily / Karthik —

Thanks for the checklist. Below are targeted answers we expect to include in the final PDF; I flagged items where we'll provide a short artifact or need an NDA.

1) Listing formats
- AWS: We support AWS Marketplace SaaS subscriptions (metering-based and buyer-initiated contracts) and can also provide AMI/container-based images for self-managed deployments. For initial GlobalTech listing we recommend SaaS Offer (simpler onboarding & metering support).
- Azure: We support transactable Azure Marketplace Offers (SaaS) and can provide a Managed Application if you require resource templates.
- GCP: SaaS listing is supported for our hosted product; we can provide container images for GCP Marketplace Private Offers on request.

2) Billing/integration
- We support marketplace-managed billing where the marketplace handles customer billing and pays Redwood per the marketplace's payout schedule. We also support private-offer flow (marketplace facilitates the transaction, but Redwood accepts a private offer). For direct, off-marketplace procurement we can accept PO/contract as well — we typically tie the payment flow to the procurement path you prefer.

3) Compliance & artifacts
- SOC 2 Type II: available; summary attached (SOC2-summary.pdf). Full report available under NDA.
- ISO 27001: statement of certification available; will provide cert copy under NDA.
- Data residency: Redwood offers regionally isolated deployments for US and EU customers; we can pin customer workloads to specific regions in our private deployment option.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys supported via KMS integrations; HSM usage available for private deployments.

4) Procurement flow & contract mechanics
- We are able to transact through marketplaces (billing via GlobalTech) or via direct contract. For marketplace-managed billing we will sign the marketplace's seller agreement and accept the marketplace invoicing model. If GlobalTech requires vendor-signed SOW/contract outside marketplace, we will accept a PO but need standard SOW terms.

5) SLAs & support
- Standard SaaS SLA: 99.9% uptime for hosted API tiers with credit policy; dedicated/enterprise tiers have higher SLOs and negotiated credits. Support: 24x5 email + priority 24x7 for enterprise customers. Escalations go through our Customer Success and On-call SRE rotation.

Attachments provided: SOC2-summary.pdf. Full artifacts (SOC2, ISO cert, pen test report) available after NDA.

Next steps: we'll finalize a compact answers PDF and return the questionnaire by EOD Tue (Apr 21). Vivek — can you confirm the Marketplace Offer packaging preferences for GlobalTech (SaaS vs private-offer) so we align the metadata and pricing fields?

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com
